Both Mongolian writing systems share Mongolia Mongolian spoken recordings. Full MP3 decode/hash verification is not pronunciation certification. See the independent recognition report for content checks. No browser speech synthesis or live speech service is used during play.

en|boy|legacy.action.accept-swap.text: Exchange together. Sticker for apple, cash unchanged; not every seller accepts stickers.

en|boy|legacy.action.allowance.text: Collect this week’s allowance once, not as daily income.

en|boy|legacy.action.assign-chores.text: Share chores. Every child helps; sorting and sweeping together earn six yuan total.

en|boy|legacy.action.assign-picnic.text: Share washing fruit, packing bread and bringing cups. Every child helps; adults fund their own meals.

en|boy|legacy.action.book-room.text: Choose to buy child room share. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.book-tickets.text: Choose to buy child ticket. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.borrow.text: Borrow the agreed principal, due tomorrow. Cash and debt rise together. Trust is not unlimited credit.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-apple.text: Choose to buy apple. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-bank-paper.text: Choose to buy supplies. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-book.text: Choose to buy storybook. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-bread.text: Choose to buy bread. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-coat.text: Choose to buy raincoat. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-foreign-souveni.text: Choose to buy island shell souvenir. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-fresh.text: Choose to buy fresh bread that keeps until tomorrow. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-gift.text: Choose to buy handmade present. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-juice.text: Choose to buy juice. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-loan-item.text: Choose to buy shared storybook. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-markdown.text: Choose to buy markdown bread for today. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-park-juice.text: Choose to buy park-stall juice. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-plush.text: Choose to buy giant plush. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-toy.text: Choose to buy little toy. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.buy-umbrella.text: Choose to buy umbrella. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.cash-out-wallet.text: Return the remaining four yuan to cash. Digital becomes zero; the snack cost one yuan.

en|boy|legacy.action.change-coins.text: Change a five-yuan note into five one-yuan coins. Different form, same total, no reward.

en|boy|legacy.action.check-bank.text: Check principal and interest returned once and supplies purchased.

en|boy|legacy.action.check-jars.text: Check your two-yuan reserve, new book and planned spending.

en|boy|legacy.action.check-price.text: Check the bread price. After tendering five yuan, collect the unspent change.

en|boy|legacy.action.check-quiet-price.text: Read the quieter-stall tag: juice is one yuan. Check before buying.

en|boy|legacy.action.close-loan.text: Close the agreement book: debt is zero and any apology plan completed.

en|boy|legacy.action.collect-change.text: Collect three yuan eighty cents. Five minus one yuan twenty is three eighty; do not deduct bread twice.

en|boy|legacy.action.collect-pay.text: Collect agreed pay after sorting and sweeping. Paid once only.

en|boy|legacy.action.collect-rest.text: Return for eighty cents. Check the receipt; change is not a reward.

en|boy|legacy.action.compare-bread.text: Compare price and shelf life. Same-day markdown bread spoils tomorrow; extra buying can lose money.

en|boy|legacy.action.compare-fx-prices.text: Compare the same souvenir: two yuan sixty at home, one shell equal to two yuan abroad. A twenty-cent whole-exchange fee also applies; not guaranteed arbitrage.

en|boy|legacy.action.compare-stalls.text: Compare the school and park juice queues and prices. School prices fall after the rush.

en|boy|legacy.action.correct-declaration.text: Correct the gift declaration. Explain goods and charges; extra fees do not disappear.

en|boy|legacy.action.customs-stamp.text: Collect the stamp with declaration and charges settled, goods retained.

en|boy|legacy.action.declare-gifts.text: Declare gifts honestly; the board sets the base charge.

en|boy|legacy.action.delay-card.text: Delay card repayment one day; one twenty-cent late fee applies. Existing debt does not disappear.

en|boy|legacy.action.deliver-bread.text: Deliver the bread after collecting all change.

en|boy|legacy.action.deliver-juice.text: Deliver one juice per child after buying enough.

en|boy|legacy.action.deposit.text: Deposit the agreed principal. Toy bank pays one percent simple interest per game-day once at maturity, not real returns. Cash becomes equal savings.

en|boy|legacy.action.exchange-home.text: Exchange all remaining shells to yuan at the current rate minus twenty cents. No balance means no fee.

en|boy|legacy.action.exchange-shells.text: Pay ten yuan twenty for five shells. Equivalent exchange preserves value; twenty-cent fee reduces net worth. No free shells.

en|boy|legacy.action.finish-travel.text: Finish the travel pages: card settled, one souvenir per child.

en|boy|legacy.action.fly-home.text: Fly home for one game-day. The fictional rate changes; foreign debt remains and the yuan bill changes.

en|boy|legacy.action.gift-plan.text: Plan to keep one yuan. Buy gifts only from this four-yuan envelope; bank saving is not compulsory.

en|boy|legacy.action.give-present.text: Give the small present and keep at least one yuan for later.

en|boy|legacy.action.hide-gifts.text: Disguise gifts as socks. Inspection requires correction and a twenty-cent extra charge; no repeat hiding.

en|boy|legacy.action.keep-picnic-savings.text: Keep matured savings for the picnic, with the new book in your bag.

en|boy|legacy.action.leave-bread.text: Leave bread until tomorrow. Markdown bread spoils, fresh lasts one more day. Replacement costs money; losses are not refunded.

en|boy|legacy.action.leave-change.text: Leave with three yuan, eighty cents short. The remaining change is still yours; return to collect it.

en|boy|legacy.action.load-wallet.text: Load five cash yuan into the wallet. Cash falls five, digital rises five; total unchanged.

en|boy|legacy.action.loan-work.text: Finish the agreed job; paid once, to help repay the loan.

en|boy|legacy.action.make-list.text: Write a list: each child needs apples and bread. Hear the per-child and total budgets.

en|boy|legacy.action.observe-shelf.text: Observe scarcity and high prices. Scarce apples cost more; delivery takes time.

en|boy|legacy.action.offer-swap.text: Offer one sticker for one apple. Keep one sticker; wait for consent before taking anything.

en|boy|legacy.action.order-home-souvenir.text: Choose to buy home shell souvenir. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.pack-lunch.text: Pack apples and bread into each child’s lunch bag.

en|boy|legacy.action.pack-souvenirs.text: Pack one souvenir per child; choose one home or foreign route for this batch.

en|boy|legacy.action.pack-weather.text: Take your purchased rain protection to the park.

en|boy|legacy.action.parent-bank.text: Visit the bank with a parent. No independent child accounts or investing; only your pocket, not parent assets.

en|boy|legacy.action.parent-card-terms.text: Read the simulated parent card terms. Foreign credit is borrowing, not free money. Repay home yuan at the current rate; one late fee of twenty cents.

en|boy|legacy.action.parent-wallet.text: Ask a parent to supervise the digital wallet. No child account; a toy demonstration.

en|boy|legacy.action.pay-bus-qr.text: Choose to buy island bus ticket. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.pay-customs.text: Pay the displayed toy customs charge; correct declarations first.

en|boy|legacy.action.pay-digital.text: Choose to buy prepaid snack. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.pay-note.text: Tender a five-yuan note for bread, then wait for change.

en|boy|legacy.action.pay-parent-card.text: Buy foreign snacks with the simulated parent credit card. Cash unchanged, foreign debt rises, repay at home.

en|boy|legacy.action.pay-sticker-qr.text: Choose to buy prepaid sticker. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|boy|legacy.action.picnic-work.text: Finish picnic preparation; collect agreed pay once. Family size changes pay and quantities.

en|boy|legacy.action.plan-trip.text: Budget with a parent: per child, transport one yuan, room share one yuan twenty, and at least three yuan for later.

en|boy|legacy.action.read-customs.text: Read toy customs: foreign gifts above four yuan cost sixty cents, not real policy. Declare quantity and value; hear the base charge.

en|boy|legacy.action.read-exchange.text: Read the board: one shell equals two yuan. Five shells cost ten yuan plus twenty cents; exchange back also costs twenty cents. A shell has one hundred small units.

en|boy|legacy.action.read-forecast.text: Read tomorrow’s forecast and rain-gear prices. Rain changes umbrella prices; raincoats stay the same.

en|boy|legacy.action.read-home-bill.text: Read rate, foreign balance and debt, fees and due date on the home bill, with parent-supervised simulated credit.

en|boy|legacy.action.read-loan.text: Read principal, daily rate and due date. Friends may charge no interest; interest-bearing loans accrue on principal once a day. Borrowing does not grow net worth.

en|boy|legacy.action.read-tags.text: Read tags and each child’s budget before buying.

en|boy|legacy.action.refund-card-snacks.text: Return unopened card snacks to reduce foreign card debt, not receive cash. No refund after settlement.

en|boy|legacy.action.repair-trust.text: Apologize and mark the next date together. Repay first; repairing trust pays no money.

en|boy|legacy.action.repay.text: Repay all principal and interest. If late, repay first, then plan dates to repair trust.

en|boy|legacy.action.reserve-two.text: Keep two yuan in the jar. It remains cash, reserved this story without interest.

en|boy|legacy.action.return-plush.text: Return the unopened plush for exactly four yuan. Choose a smaller gift, with no extra money.

en|boy|legacy.action.review-card-bill.text: Inspect the new home bill. The exchange rate changes its value; cash is not auto-deducted. Repay next story.

en|boy|legacy.action.ride-island-bus.text: Pay each child’s prepaid fare and ride the island bus, without borrowing.

en|boy|legacy.action.seal-reserve.text: Label and reserve two yuan. A book uses another two; the remote duck must wait.

en|boy|legacy.action.seal-trip-budget.text: Buy tickets and room shares, reserve next-leg funds, then depart.

en|boy|legacy.action.serve-bread.text: Serve edible bread to each child, never spoiled bread.

en|boy|legacy.action.settle-parent-card.text: Settle the parent card in yuan at the current rate, including late fees, not a second snack charge.

en|boy|legacy.action.share-apples.text: Share the apples at home, with one for each child.

en|boy|legacy.action.share-swap-snack.text: Share the swapped and purchased apples; keep one sticker.

en|boy|legacy.action.show-room.text: Show your finished room to a parent.

en|boy|legacy.action.sort-socks.text: Sort socks and books. Give siblings manageable tasks and share the credit.

en|boy|legacy.action.sort-stickers.text: Sort two existing duplicate stickers once; this is not printing money.

en|boy|legacy.action.start-picnic.text: Enjoy a picnic with apples, bread and juice for every child; savings withdrawn and debts settled.

en|boy|legacy.action.sweep-room.text: Sweep together. This agreement pays once, not daily button money.

en|boy|legacy.action.travel-envelope.text: Collect the children’s travel envelope once; parent costs are separate.

en|boy|legacy.action.unload-truck.text: Open crates to observe, without payment. Apple prices change from one yuan fifty to eighty cents.

en|boy|legacy.action.wait-bank.text: Wait one game-day and check maturity. Interest settles once only when due; early withdrawal forfeits it.

en|boy|legacy.action.wait-crowd.text: Wait one game-day for the crowd to leave; existing loan interest advances too.

en|boy|legacy.action.wait-delivery.text: Wait one game-day for delivery. Dates and existing interest advance too.

en|boy|legacy.action.wait-due.text: Wait one game-day to the repayment date; interest-bearing loans add one day’s simple interest.

en|boy|legacy.action.wait-late.text: Play two days and repay late. Trust drops one; interest continues. Repay and apologize to recover.

en|boy|legacy.action.wait-weather.text: Sleep and inspect the sky. Tomorrow’s tags appear first; owned rain gear has no extra price charge.

en|boy|legacy.action.withdraw.text: Withdraw the bank balance into cash without increasing total wealth. Early principal withdrawal forfeits interest; redeposit is possible.

en|boy|legacy.allowance.body.text: A parent sets out spend, keep and share jars: money does not grow daily. Collect this week’s six yuan, reserve two yuan, buy a two yuan book, then check the plan.

en|boy|legacy.bank-plan.body.text: A parent: this is your pocket, not the family’s wealth. Keep two yuan for tomorrow and read today. Collect six yuan allowance, deposit two yuan with a parent, buy a two yuan book and wait one game-day.

en|boy|legacy.bank-term.body.text: Beaver Banker: toy bank, one percent simple interest per game-day. Early withdrawal returns principal only; not real returns. With a parent, deposit three yuan for two game-days, withdraw three yuan and six cents, then buy one yuan supplies.

en|boy|legacy.barter.body.text: Le has apples; you have duplicate stickers. A swap needs two happy yeses. Sort two stickers, trade one for an apple, then buy one extra apple per child.

en|boy|legacy.birthday.body.text: Grandma says: you choose. A giant plush eats the envelope; a small gift brings smiles too. Receive four yuan gift money, buy a present from it, and keep at least one yuan.

en|boy|legacy.borrow.body.text: Le says: borrow two yuan and return it tomorrow. A loan is not a gift. Agree to borrow two yuan, buy a three yuan shared book, do a job and repay tomorrow.

en|boy|legacy.change.body.text: Baker Bee tried calling her calculator. Help check your change! Pay five yuan for one yuan and twenty cents bread, collect the right change, and deliver it.

en|boy|legacy.chores.body.text: A parent says: the sock monster took the sofa! Share jobs, not sibling jobs. Assign shared chores, sort and sweep, then collect one agreed payment.

en|boy|legacy.common.already.text: Already done: no repeated payments, borrowing or purchases.

en|boy|legacy.common.borrow-result.text: The borrowed money reached your pocket and debt rose too. Principal, daily rate and due date are recorded; this is not income.

en|boy|legacy.common.card-refund-result.text: Unopened snacks returned and their debt reversed. No cash or shells were paid out.

en|boy|legacy.common.cash-purchase.text: This purchase uses your own cash. Hear the quantity, price and budget before deciding.

en|boy|legacy.common.change-result.text: The change collected this time is back in your pocket. Uncollected change remains owed by the shopkeeper, not a new reward.

en|boy|legacy.common.changes.text: Here is what that choice changed.

en|boy|legacy.common.complete.text: Complete! Pouch choices became everyday smiles. Hear changes in money and goods.

en|boy|legacy.common.consume-result.text: The goods have been shared. Every child received a portion; shared goods are no longer in your bag.

en|boy|legacy.common.deposit-result.text: Cash moved equally into savings. Principal is still yours; interest settles at the agreed maturity, not as repeated daily rewards.

en|boy|legacy.common.early-result.text: Principal withdrawn early; unmatured interest was forfeited. You can redeposit and wait for maturity.

en|boy|legacy.common.foreign-purchase.text: Buy with your own shell-wallet money; the price is in shells.

en|boy|legacy.common.funds.text: This pouch or budget is not enough. Hear costs and check other work or recovery; retry is available.

en|boy|legacy.common.fx-result.text: Exchange completed. One pouch fell and the other rose; the fee is the part spent. Rate changes also revalue foreign money and debt in home currency.

en|boy|legacy.common.liquidity-held.text: The bank has set aside settlement money that unlocks in a few days. If repayment comes first, it can sell pledged bonds, invite new shareholder cash, or wait for the money to unlock.

en|boy|legacy.common.matured.text: Maturity interest is recorded in savings; principal remains at the bank.

en|boy|legacy.common.obligations-pending.text: Shop, bank or trade obligations remain. Use the repayment or waiting choices below before closing the album.

en|boy|legacy.common.prepaid-purchase.text: You spend your own money already loaded into the digital wallet, not a loan.

en|boy|legacy.common.prepare.text: Finish the preparation first, then hear this choice's agreement.

en|boy|legacy.common.purchase.text: Payment, goods and bills updated. Hear changes: prepaid is not borrowing; credit must be repaid.

en|boy|legacy.common.purchase-result.text: Payment completed. Bought goods are in your bag; the seller received the money.

en|boy|legacy.common.refund-result.text: Return completed and the matching goods went back. A cash purchase refunds its original price; card snacks reverse their debt, with no free payout.

en|boy|legacy.common.repay-result.text: This debt was repaid. Cash and matching debt fell together, not a second purchase. If it was late, apologize and plan the next date.

en|boy|legacy.common.reserve-result.text: The reserve label is on. The money is still in your pocket, set aside this story without interest.

en|boy|legacy.common.spoiled-result.text: Markdown bread spoiled and cannot be served. No refund for the loss; buy fresh replacement or retry this story to continue.

en|boy|legacy.common.stock.text: This item was bought, sold out today, or an alternative was chosen. Check preparation and other choices.

en|boy|legacy.common.swap-result.text: Both sides exchanged together. Stickers fell, apples rose and cash stayed unchanged.

en|boy|legacy.common.time.text: Game days moved forward. Prices, dates and agreed interest updated; hear the new bill before paying.

en|boy|legacy.common.updated.text: This action was processed. Hear the agreement and current goods, pouches and debt.

en|boy|legacy.common.visit.text: Rest here. Hear today's goal, then follow footprints to the story.

en|boy|legacy.common.wallet-result.text: Cash and prepaid digital money have been transferred. Both are your own money, not borrowing; transferring does not raise the total.

en|boy|legacy.common.withdraw-result.text: The bank balance moved back to your pocket. Early withdrawal earns no interest for this term; principal is not new income.

en|boy|legacy.common.work.text: Agreed work is done and payment arrived. No sneaky naps for Sock Monster!

en|boy|legacy.currency.body.text: Captain Coin: five one yuan coins equal one five yuan note! Digital balance is not free money. Change five yuan into coins, load it into a digital wallet with a parent, pay one yuan and return the rest.

en|boy|legacy.demand.body.text: Juice Jo: the race ended and everyone is thirsty! Buy now or after the rush? Check the queue, compare juice prices, buy a cup each and deliver them.

en|boy|legacy.due-date.body.text: Le drew a tomato on the calendar: the red circle means tomorrow, not forever-tomorrow. Borrow three yuan for supplies, do the agreed job and repay by the date; repair trust if late.

en|boy|legacy.due-date.title.text: The red circle on the calendar

en|boy|legacy.first-snack.body.text: Apple Uncle made a fruit caterpillar: check the price before choosing! Buy an apple for each child within one yuan each, then share them.

en|boy|legacy.foreign-exchange.body.text: Parrot Teller: one shell = two yuan, with zero yuan and twenty cents per exchange. A QR payment can spend your own money, not borrow! Read fictional rates and fees, exchange for five shell coins, then pay children’s bus fares from the prepaid wallet.

en|boy|legacy.foreign-exchange.title.text: Shell coins are not free shells

en|boy|legacy.item.fresh.text: fresh bread that keeps until tomorrow

en|boy|legacy.loan-interest.body.text: A parent reads the toy terms: one percent of principal per game-day, four yuan costs four cents a day, not a real loan. Read terms, borrow four yuan for a kit, work, then repay principal plus interest after a game-day.

en|boy|legacy.loan-interest.title.text: A loan with a little tail

en|boy|legacy.markdown.body.text: Baker Bee: markdown bread is tasty today; tomorrow it parties in the compost bin. Compare fresh and same-day markdown bread; prepare edible snacks for every child.

en|boy|legacy.parent-card.body.text: Parent: this is my simulated card, not a child credit account. Credit borrows; names like Alipay or PayPal alone do not say whether a payment borrows. Check its funding source. With a parent, use a simulated parent credit card for foreign snacks and inspect the home-currency bill after returning.

en|boy|legacy.picnic.body.text: Family outing! Parents pay their own meals; your pocket buys the children’s snacks. Sock Monster brings napkins. Share preparation, withdraw available savings, buy each child apple, bread and juice, and leave no debt.

en|boy|legacy.school-list.body.text: Bear the shopkeeper says: a toy dinosaur wants in, but lunch cannot be a dinosaur. Pack an apple and bread for each child within two yuan and fifty cents each.

en|boy|legacy.supply.body.text: Apple Uncle: ducks blocked the truck! Empty shelves changed today’s price. Notice scarce apples cost more; wait for delivery or buy now, then share one each.

en|boy|legacy.toy-customs.body.text: Crab Officer: toy rules, not real customs policy. Overseas gifts above four yuan cost this envelope zero yuan and sixty cents. Declare them; do not disguise them as socks! Read fictional customs rules, declare souvenirs, pay the displayed charge and obtain a stamp.

en|boy|legacy.toy-customs.title.text: A customs stamp is not a sticker

en|boy|legacy.travel-budget.body.text: Parent: let’s visit fictional Shell Island! This envelope covers children, not adult flights. With a parent, budget the children’s travel envelope, book transport and a room share, and reserve next-leg funds.

en|boy|legacy.travel-finale.body.text: Parrot Post: repay in yuan at home; do not throw away shell IOUs! Every child gets a souvenir page. Exchange leftover shells back, settle the parent’s simulated card at the displayed rate, and keep one souvenir per child.

en|boy|legacy.travel-prices.body.text: Shell Seller: the same item is two yuan and sixty cents at home, one shell here; the exchange has a zero yuan and twenty cents fee. Fictional prices today, not a universal bargain rule. Convert home and shell prices for the same souvenir; choose one for each child.

en|boy|legacy.weather.body.text: Cloud the courier brings a forecast: sunny today, maybe rain tomorrow. Umbrella prices change. Read tomorrow’s forecast, buy rain protection and prepare for the park.

en|boy|life.album.bold.text: Picnic together and talk about choices through the years.

en|boy|life.album.goal.text: The child with a little purse has lived a whole story. Photos and family ages remain. There is more than one good path.

en|boy|life.album.result.text: From childhood until now, family and stories are in the album. Replay a chapter to try another route.

en|boy|life.album.safe.text: Garden with family and open the old photos.

en|boy|life.basket.bold.text: Demand crowds in: prices become one point three, two point six and three point nine yuan.

en|boy|life.basket.goal.text: Three goods began at one, two and three yuan. Compare the whole basket, not one apple price alone.

en|boy|life.basket.result.text: Old and new prices of the same basket were recorded. Unchanged money can buy a different amount.

en|boy|life.basket.safe.text: Supply recovers: prices become zero point nine, one point eight and two point seven yuan.

en|boy|life.bond-market.bold.text: Receive the coupon, then sell to another investor for nine yuan.

en|boy|life.bond-market.goal.text: Coupon stays zero point five yuan, but resale price changes. Secondary-sale money goes to the seller, not the issuer again.

en|boy|life.bond-market.result.text: A bond resale swaps money between holders; it does not fund the issuer again. Its market price can change.

en|boy|life.bond-market.safe.text: Receive the coupon and hold; today’s quote is ten point five yuan.

en|boy|life.bond.bold.text: Pay ten yuan for a new bond; money goes to the bakery company.

en|boy|life.bond.goal.text: A bond is a loan promise: principal ten yuan, fixed coupon zero point five, maturity in three turns.

en|boy|life.bond.result.text: A bond records principal and interest separately. Its holder has a claim and the shop has a repayment obligation.

en|boy|life.bond.safe.text: Skip buying this time and keep cash.

en|boy|life.budget.bold.text: Save another three yuan and keep more cash nearby.

en|boy|life.budget.goal.text: Pay twelve yuan living costs and one per childhood sibling group member. Saving moves money, not creates income.

en|boy|life.budget.result.text: Living costs are paid. Emergency money moved from your pocket to savings; that transfer did not create wealth.

en|boy|life.budget.safe.text: Move another ten yuan into emergency savings.

en|boy|life.children.bold.text: Care for two children for six yuan this turn.

en|boy|life.children.goal.text: Now you have your own family. Children grow with the chapters. Care needs money and time.

en|boy|life.children.result.text: New babies joined your family. Care needs money and shared family time.

en|boy|life.children.safe.text: Care for one child for three yuan this turn.

en|boy|life.claim.bold.text: Repair with family, then check the same claim rules.

en|boy|life.claim.goal.text: Rain damage costs five or fifteen yuan. Repair first, then claim from the pool within the deductible and limit.

en|boy|life.claim.result.text: Repairs were paid first. Insurance reimburses only loss above the deductible and within its limit.

en|boy|life.claim.safe.text: Report the loss honestly and check covered and uncovered costs.

en|boy|life.constraints.bold.text: Risk is too high and nobody wants to borrow; decline new credit this turn.

en|boy|life.constraints.goal.text: Capital, liquidity, risk and loan demand constrain lending. Reserves times a number do not automatically create loans.

en|boy|life.constraints.result.text: The bank also checks risk, funds and borrower demand. Low rates do not approve every loan.

en|boy|life.constraints.safe.text: Shrink the plan and repay five yuan principal; loans and deposits both fall.

en|boy|life.credit.bold.text: Approve a twenty-yuan business loan: deposits rise twenty, reserves stay put.

en|boy|life.credit.goal.text: A bank loan creates a borrower deposit and bank loan asset, alongside borrower debt. Reserves are not loan assets.

en|boy|life.credit.result.text: The bank added a loan asset and a borrower deposit together. Lending itself did not increase bank reserves.

en|boy|life.credit.safe.text: Approve a ten-yuan business loan: deposits rise ten, reserves stay put.

en|boy|life.credit.title.text: A loan makes two matching records

en|boy|life.demand.bold.text: Charge one point six yuan each; sell up to four today.

en|boy|life.demand.goal.text: A higher price need not earn more. Unsold bread becomes compost, not spendable cash.

en|boy|life.demand.result.text: Customers buy some bread; unsold bread expires and loses its inventory value. A large backlog also costs twenty yuan to clear. A sole owner covers the shortfall; a limited company keeps its own unpaid debt.

en|boy|life.demand.safe.text: Charge one yuan each; sell up to eight today.

en|boy|life.elder.bold.text: Hire care help and visit too, for four yuan.

en|boy|life.elder.goal.text: Parents are getting older too. Visits, shared care and nursing all help; earning money is not the only way.

en|boy|life.elder.result.text: Elder care is arranged. Relatives keep growing older, and family responsibilities change.

en|boy|life.elder.safe.text: Take family turns visiting; care costs two yuan.

en|boy|life.equity.bold.text: Company receives twenty yuan; the new partner owns one fifth.

en|boy|life.equity.goal.text: Issuing shares shrinks your ownership percentage. Investment goes to the company, not your pocket.

en|boy|life.equity.result.text: New investment changes the original owner’s share. The route without a new shareholder completes prepaid orders first.

en|boy|life.equity.safe.text: Do not issue shares. Deliver prepaid orders for three yuan of materials.

en|boy|life.exchange.bold.text: Exchange at one point eight yuan per shell.

en|boy|life.exchange.goal.text: Foreign payment must become yuan. In an adverse credit sale only three quarters arrive; FX also changes receipts.

en|boy|life.exchange.result.text: Foreign payment settled into shop cash at this exchange rate. A short-paying credit customer returns less than the invoice.

en|boy|life.exchange.safe.text: Exchange at two point two yuan per shell.

en|boy|life.export.bold.text: Sell on credit for four shells; record a receivable that may not all arrive.

en|boy|life.export.goal.text: Production costs four yuan, freight one, customs zero point five. Sending goods and receiving payment are separate.

en|boy|life.export.result.text: Production, freight and customs are paid. Foreign money received is different from a foreign receivable awaiting payment.

en|boy|life.export.safe.text: Use escrow for three shell coins: a lower price, safer payment.

en|boy|life.facility.bold.text: The bank pledges five yuan of bonds and borrows five yuan of reserves from the central bank. After two turns it repays principal and five cents of interest, then receives collateral back.

en|boy|life.facility.goal.text: Borrowing central-bank reserves creates bank debt. Placing reserves in a facility changes accounts, not household income.

en|boy|life.facility.result.text: Standing facilities are deposits or loans between the bank and central bank, not gifts to households.

en|boy|life.facility.safe.text: The bank places five yuan of reserves in a standing facility. After two turns it receives principal and five cents of interest, not household income.

en|boy|life.finance.bold.text: Borrow twenty yuan, due in three turns. Interest is zero point four per turn, collateral twenty.

en|boy|life.finance.goal.text: Prepaid orders need delivery. Loans need principal and interest repaid. Borrowed money is not new personal wealth.

en|boy|life.finance.result.text: The shop has funding. A loan owes interest; an order prepayment owes delivery. Neither is free money.

en|boy|life.finance.safe.text: Take five small orders, receive five yuan, and owe delivery costing three yuan.

en|boy|life.housing.bold.text: Buy a one hundred-yuan home: twenty down, eighty loan, one point six interest.

en|boy|life.housing.goal.text: A home is for living. Renting is flexible; buying brings a loan and repairs. Prices do not only rise.

en|boy|life.housing.result.text: Rent pays for use. Buying pays a down payment and owes a bank mortgage. The home was not received for free.

en|boy|life.housing.safe.text: Rent a cottage for five yuan this turn.

en|boy|life.insurance.bold.text: Skip cover and keep money for repairs yourself.

en|boy|life.insurance.goal.text: Families share an insurance pool. Premium one yuan, deductible three, limit ten. Losses are not always fully covered.

en|boy|life.insurance.result.text: Premiums enter a shared insurance pool. Cover has a deductible and a payout limit.

en|boy|life.insurance.safe.text: Pay one yuan premium for this turn’s cover.

en|boy|life.job.bold.text: Work farther away: sixty yuan wage, fifteen travel, six tax.

en|boy|life.job.goal.text: You are eighteen! Compare wages, travel costs and tax before choosing a job.

en|boy|life.job.result.text: Your wage arrived. Commuting costs and tax were paid. What remains can cover everyday life.

en|boy|life.job.safe.text: Work nearby: forty five yuan wage, three travel, four point five tax.

en|boy|life.leverage.bold.text: Borrow ten yuan for more shares, due in three turns, interest zero point two yuan.

en|boy|life.leverage.goal.text: Blue blocks are your money; orange blocks must be repaid. Falling asset prices do not erase debt.

en|boy|life.leverage.result.text: With borrowed investment money, asset prices can change while principal and interest remain owed.

en|boy|life.leverage.safe.text: Do not borrow; keep the existing holding.

en|boy|life.materials.bold.text: Pay eight yuan for twenty portions of materials.

en|boy|life.materials.goal.text: Buying materials uses cash. Flour is not sold bread. Think about how much you can make.

en|boy|life.materials.result.text: Materials are ready. Buying more at once uses more shop cash before any sales arrive.

en|boy|life.materials.safe.text: Pay four yuan for ten portions of materials.

en|boy|life.notes.bold.text: Withdraw one yuan if saved; without a deposit, printed notes stay in the vault.

en|boy|life.notes.goal.text: Printed notes alone do not give anyone more money. Cash withdrawal and deposit exchange cash, reserves and deposits.

en|boy|life.notes.result.text: Cash and deposits exchange through the accounts. Printed but unissued notes do not increase household money.

en|boy|life.notes.safe.text: Deposit one yuan cash; bank deposit rises by one.

en|boy|life.open-market.bold.text: Central bank buys a ten-yuan bond; bank reserves rise ten.

en|boy|life.open-market.goal.text: Central-bank asset trades have matching reserve changes. Base money and household deposits are not the same number.

en|boy|life.open-market.result.text: The central bank and bank exchanged bonds and reserves. Account changes do not instantly add goods to shops.

en|boy|life.open-market.safe.text: Central bank sells a five-yuan bond; bank reserves fall five.

en|boy|life.organization.bold.text: Run a sole business and take personal responsibility.

en|boy|life.organization.goal.text: Choose ownership and responsibility. Limited liability does not allow taking company money to dodge debts.

en|boy|life.organization.result.text: Your partner’s old stake has been bought out. The new business form determines who bears its unpaid bills.

en|boy|life.organization.safe.text: Choose limited liability and separate household and company books.

en|boy|life.production.bold.text: Hire more helpers and pay three yuan in wages.

en|boy|life.production.goal.text: Turn materials into bread within oven capacity. Pay wages before sales arrive.

en|boy|life.production.result.text: The oven used available materials and capacity to make bread. The shop paid wages for the work.

en|boy|life.production.safe.text: Join the work and pay one point five yuan in wages.

en|boy|life.profit.bold.text: Take more orders and sell eight yuan. Subtract three yuan before sharing profit.

en|boy|life.profit.goal.text: Materials cost two yuan and wages one. Subtract costs before sharing profit.

en|boy|life.profit.result.text: Sales paid for materials and wages first. The remaining profit was shared between both owners.

en|boy|life.profit.safe.text: Sell six yuan of goods. Subtract three yuan of costs, then share profit.

en|boy|life.public-bond.bold.text: Buy and hold a ten-yuan public bond. Receive thirty cents next turn and await principal repayment on the third turn.

en|boy|life.public-bond.goal.text: Lending government ten yuan creates a claim and debt. Coupon is zero point three; returned principal is not interest.

en|boy|life.public-bond.result.text: Government bonds record public borrowing. Paying interest and returning principal are different payments.

en|boy|life.public-bond.safe.text: Buy a ten-yuan public bond, then resell for nine yuan eighty cents. Government receives the issue payment; the next buyer pays for resale.

en|boy|life.purchasing.bold.text: Buy the whole basket at today’s prices.

en|boy|life.purchasing.goal.text: Revisit the basket. An unchanged balance may buy a different amount; falling prices also affect income and debt.

en|boy|life.purchasing.result.text: Today’s shopping used today’s basket prices. Look at savings numbers together with the life they can actually buy.

en|boy|life.purchasing.safe.text: Buy two thirds of the basket at today’s prices.

en|boy|life.rates.bold.text: Announce a new five percent rate per turn.

en|boy|life.rates.goal.text: The rate change takes two turns. Without demand or bank willingness, a cut does not guarantee new loans.

en|boy|life.rates.result.text: The rate decision takes effect later and changes new loan quotes. Existing promises are not secretly rewritten.

en|boy|life.rates.safe.text: Announce a new one percent rate per turn.

en|boy|life.rates.title.text: A letter from the central bank

en|boy|life.recovery.bold.text: Pay interest and repay the share-purchase loan.

en|boy|life.recovery.goal.text: Shares may fall thirty percent or rise ten. Check interest and collateral; a smaller plan can help.

en|boy|life.recovery.result.text: Assets were repriced by this market event. Selling turns them into cash; extending a loan does not erase interest.

en|boy|life.recovery.safe.text: Pay interest and negotiate three extra turns with revalued collateral.

en|boy|life.recovery.title.text: A fall is not the end

en|boy|life.reserves.bold.text: Set the story’s reserve requirement to twenty percent.

en|boy|life.reserves.goal.text: Changing required reserves changes one constraint. Risk, capital and demand still matter.

en|boy|life.reserves.result.text: Reserve requirements changed the settlement funds a bank must keep, while capital and risk limits remain.

en|boy|life.reserves.safe.text: Set the story’s reserve requirement to five percent.

en|boy|life.retirement.bold.text: Plan nine yuan living costs for more activities.

en|boy|life.retirement.goal.text: Pension is ten yuan this turn; wages no longer arrive automatically. Care for living costs and settle outstanding loans.

en|boy|life.retirement.result.text: Retirement income and living costs are separate. Retiring does not automatically erase repayment obligations.

en|boy|life.retirement.safe.text: Plan six yuan living costs, leaving some room.

en|boy|life.services.bold.text: Spend thirty government yuan on a bridge, increasing order demand.

en|boy|life.services.goal.text: The public purse cannot do everything at once. A bridge helps deliveries; a clinic helps care.

en|boy|life.services.result.text: The public budget paid service providers. Money spent here cannot fund another service at the same time.

en|boy|life.services.safe.text: Spend twenty government yuan on a clinic.

en|boy|life.settlement.bold.text: Pay eight yuan across banks; one reserve falls and the other rises.

en|boy|life.settlement.goal.text: Company banks at A, household at B. Deposits change owners and bank reserves settle too.

en|boy|life.settlement.result.text: Wages arrived across banks. Customer deposits and reserves between banks each have matching transfers.

en|boy|life.settlement.safe.text: Pay five yuan across banks; one reserve falls and the other rises.

en|boy|life.shares.bold.text: Buy more existing shares for ten yuan.

en|boy|life.shares.goal.text: Buy existing shares from their owner. The company gets none of this payment, and prices can fall.

en|boy|life.shares.result.text: You bought shares from an existing holder. The seller received your money, not the company.

en|boy|life.shares.safe.text: Buy a small holding of existing shares for five yuan.

en|boy|life.sourcing.bold.text: Import ten portions: five yuan goods, one shipping, one customs; total seven.

en|boy|life.sourcing.goal.text: Imported materials include shipping and customs. A low tag need not mean a low delivered price.

en|boy|life.sourcing.result.text: Materials followed the chosen route. Compare overseas factory prices only after adding freight and customs costs.

en|boy|life.sourcing.safe.text: Buy ten local portions for six yuan total.

en|boy|life.stall.bold.text: Put in six yuan for a sixty percent share.

en|boy|life.stall.goal.text: With a parent, start a partnership. Ownership follows contributions; wages are separate.

en|boy|life.stall.result.text: Your contribution and your partner’s contribution are in the stall. Wages and ownership profits are recorded separately.

en|boy|life.stall.safe.text: Put in four yuan for a forty percent share.

en|boy|life.studio.bold.text: Invest twenty yuan, pay eight rent, make at most twenty per batch.

en|boy|life.studio.goal.text: Rent comes first. Compare equipment and capacity. A small bakery can make lovely bread too.

en|boy|life.studio.result.text: Your contribution entered the shop pouch, and rent went to the landlord. Watch cash and oven capacity together.

en|boy|life.studio.safe.text: Invest ten yuan, pay four rent, make at most ten per batch.

en|boy|life.tax.bold.text: Choose a larger budget and pay eight yuan tax.

en|boy|life.tax.goal.text: Earn forty yuan this turn. Tax enters government accounts; public services need a budget.

en|boy|life.tax.result.text: Wages and tax are separate. Tax moved from the household pouch to the public pouch; it did not vanish.

en|boy|life.tax.safe.text: Choose a smaller budget and pay four yuan tax.

en|boy|life.towns.bold.text: Make everything yourself: pay seven yuan for eight, receive eight yuan.

en|boy|life.towns.goal.text: Apple Town saves time on materials; Bread Town on baking. Compare forgone output before sharing work.

en|boy|life.towns.result.text: Two places supplied goods at different costs. Compare how much bread the same budget brought back after trade.

en|boy|life.towns.safe.text: Specialize and trade: pay six yuan for ten, receive eight yuan.

en|boy|life.upkeep.bold.text: Check a ten-yuan price fall, then make agreed payments.

en|boy|life.upkeep.goal.text: Owners pay three yuan repairs, one point six interest and five principal. Renters pay five this turn; the books differ.

en|boy|life.upkeep.result.text: Upkeep, mortgage interest and principal repayment are separate entries. A falling home price does not cancel debt.

en|boy|life.upkeep.safe.text: Care for the home and make agreed payments.

en|boy|ui.audio-missing.text: This recording is not ready yet. Ask a grown-up to read with you.

en|boy|ui.audio-unavailable.text: Recordings are not ready. Complete text remains; try replay later.

en|boy|ui.contribute.text: Put ten yuan from your own pocket into the bakery’s money pouch.

en|boy|ui.credit-approved.text: This application passed. The loan asset and borrower deposit increased together; lending itself added no reserves.

en|boy|ui.credit-declined.text: This request did not pass for now. Changed rates still require demand, acceptable risk, capital and settlement funds.

en|boy|ui.delivery-pending.text: The goods are still travelling. Delivery time and quantities are in the trade record.

en|boy|ui.demand.text: Take a real bread order and explain a repayment plan, so the bank can review demand and risk again.

en|boy|ui.facility-recovered.text: The bank raised settlement funds to repay its central-bank loan. Pledged bonds and new capital have matching records.

en|boy|ui.facility-recovery.text: Arrange bank repayment and new capital

en|boy|ui.facility-recovery-detail.text: Sell pledged bonds for settlement funds first; investors contribute new capital for any shortfall. Existing owners do not receive free money.

en|boy|ui.facility-restructured.text: The bank has temporarily rescheduled repayment; the debt has not disappeared.

en|boy|ui.family-one.text: I am the only child in my family. My family will help me grow through the story.

en|boy|ui.family-three.text: There are three children in my family. We will grow together and include everyone when sharing.

en|boy|ui.family-two.text: There are two children in my family. We will grow up and share things together.

en|boy|ui.observe.text: See how money and life changed

en|boy|ui.panel-help.text: Hear your little goal, then each choice. The speaker beside a choice only reads it and never chooses for you. Check the result after choosing.

en|boy|ui.panel-journal.text: This is your growing-up album. Highlighted stories are ones you have lived; future stories come as you grow.

en|boy|ui.panel-reset.text: Starting again returns to the first childhood story and replaces current progress.

en|boy|ui.panel-retry.text: Retry restores this story’s starting pouches and promises. The same event does not secretly change on retry.

en|boy|ui.panel-settings.text: Change language or sound here. Speech uses only prerecorded audio; stop or replay whenever you like.

en|boy|ui.panel-wallet.text: These are your pouches and promises. Cash, savings and debts are separate; never count the same debt twice.

en|boy|ui.pay-supplier-detail.text: Use company cash to clear the unpaid materials bill. If cash is short, earn wages and contribute your own money to the shop.

en|boy|ui.payment-pending.text: Delivery has arrived, but payment is pending. Some goods may be damaged; a receivable is not cash in hand.

en|boy|ui.repay-company.text: Use the shop’s money to repay its remaining bank-loan principal and accrued interest.

en|boy|ui.repay-house.text: Repay your remaining bank-loan principal and accrued interest.

en|boy|ui.reserve.text: In retirement, move one yuan of savings into your pocket, without borrowing.

en|boy|ui.retirement-work.text: I choose an occasional retirement job for twenty-five yuan, then plan my rest. Wages are recorded, and old loan interest continues.

en|boy|ui.sell-home.text: Sell your home for cash at its current price and pay five yuan in rent. Selling does not automatically cancel the mortgage.

en|boy|ui.setup.text: Choose a boy or a girl, then a family with one, two or three children. Every family belongs!

en|boy|ui.shift.text: Do a paid shift for fifty yuan; time moves one turn.

en|boy|ui.supplier-paid.text: The supplier has been paid and the unpaid company bill is cleared.

en|boy|ui.test-credit.text: Wait a game turn and request a new five-yuan loan. See how central-bank tools and bank review work together.

en|boy|ui.trade-arrived.text: This trade has settled. Check delivered goods, foreign cash and losses before exchanging currency.

en|boy|ui.trade-pending.text: Delivery or payment is still pending. Wait a game turn and check again.

en|boy|ui.unavailable.text: This step is not available. Do a paid shift or choose a smaller plan.

en|boy|ui.wait-trade.text: Wait for delivery or customer payment

en|boy|ui.wait-trade-detail.text: Wait one game turn. Delivery and payment take their agreed time; existing loan interest still accrues.

en|girl|legacy.action.accept-swap.text: Exchange together. Sticker for apple, cash unchanged; not every seller accepts stickers.

en|girl|legacy.action.allowance.text: Collect this week’s allowance once, not as daily income.

en|girl|legacy.action.assign-chores.text: Share chores. Every child helps; sorting and sweeping together earn six yuan total.

en|girl|legacy.action.assign-picnic.text: Share washing fruit, packing bread and bringing cups. Every child helps; adults fund their own meals.

en|girl|legacy.action.book-room.text: Choose to buy child room share. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.book-tickets.text: Choose to buy child ticket. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.borrow.text: Borrow the agreed principal, due tomorrow. Cash and debt rise together. Trust is not unlimited credit.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-apple.text: Choose to buy apple. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-bank-paper.text: Choose to buy supplies. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-book.text: Choose to buy storybook. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-bread.text: Choose to buy bread. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-coat.text: Choose to buy raincoat. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-foreign-souven.text: Choose to buy island shell souvenir. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-fresh.text: Choose to buy fresh bread that keeps until tomorrow. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-gift.text: Choose to buy handmade present. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-juice.text: Choose to buy juice. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-loan-item.text: Choose to buy shared storybook. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-markdown.text: Choose to buy markdown bread for today. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-park-juice.text: Choose to buy park-stall juice. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-plush.text: Choose to buy giant plush. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-toy.text: Choose to buy little toy. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.buy-umbrella.text: Choose to buy umbrella. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.cash-out-wallet.text: Return the remaining four yuan to cash. Digital becomes zero; the snack cost one yuan.

en|girl|legacy.action.change-coins.text: Change a five-yuan note into five one-yuan coins. Different form, same total, no reward.

en|girl|legacy.action.check-bank.text: Check principal and interest returned once and supplies purchased.

en|girl|legacy.action.check-jars.text: Check your two-yuan reserve, new book and planned spending.

en|girl|legacy.action.check-price.text: Check the bread price. After tendering five yuan, collect the unspent change.

en|girl|legacy.action.check-quiet-price.text: Read the quieter-stall tag: juice is one yuan. Check before buying.

en|girl|legacy.action.close-loan.text: Close the agreement book: debt is zero and any apology plan completed.

en|girl|legacy.action.collect-change.text: Collect three yuan eighty cents. Five minus one yuan twenty is three eighty; do not deduct bread twice.

en|girl|legacy.action.collect-pay.text: Collect agreed pay after sorting and sweeping. Paid once only.

en|girl|legacy.action.collect-rest.text: Return for eighty cents. Check the receipt; change is not a reward.

en|girl|legacy.action.compare-bread.text: Compare price and shelf life. Same-day markdown bread spoils tomorrow; extra buying can lose money.

en|girl|legacy.action.compare-fx-prices.text: Compare the same souvenir: two yuan sixty at home, one shell equal to two yuan abroad. A twenty-cent whole-exchange fee also applies; not guaranteed arbitrage.

en|girl|legacy.action.compare-stalls.text: Compare the school and park juice queues and prices. School prices fall after the rush.

en|girl|legacy.action.correct-declaratio.text: Correct the gift declaration. Explain goods and charges; extra fees do not disappear.

en|girl|legacy.action.customs-stamp.text: Collect the stamp with declaration and charges settled, goods retained.

en|girl|legacy.action.declare-gifts.text: Declare gifts honestly; the board sets the base charge.

en|girl|legacy.action.delay-card.text: Delay card repayment one day; one twenty-cent late fee applies. Existing debt does not disappear.

en|girl|legacy.action.deliver-bread.text: Deliver the bread after collecting all change.

en|girl|legacy.action.deliver-juice.text: Deliver one juice per child after buying enough.

en|girl|legacy.action.deposit.text: Deposit the agreed principal. Toy bank pays one percent simple interest per game-day once at maturity, not real returns. Cash becomes equal savings.

en|girl|legacy.action.exchange-home.text: Exchange all remaining shells to yuan at the current rate minus twenty cents. No balance means no fee.

en|girl|legacy.action.exchange-shells.text: Pay ten yuan twenty for five shells. Equivalent exchange preserves value; twenty-cent fee reduces net worth. No free shells.

en|girl|legacy.action.finish-travel.text: Finish the travel pages: card settled, one souvenir per child.

en|girl|legacy.action.fly-home.text: Fly home for one game-day. The fictional rate changes; foreign debt remains and the yuan bill changes.

en|girl|legacy.action.gift-plan.text: Plan to keep one yuan. Buy gifts only from this four-yuan envelope; bank saving is not compulsory.

en|girl|legacy.action.give-present.text: Give the small present and keep at least one yuan for later.

en|girl|legacy.action.hide-gifts.text: Disguise gifts as socks. Inspection requires correction and a twenty-cent extra charge; no repeat hiding.

en|girl|legacy.action.keep-picnic-saving.text: Keep matured savings for the picnic, with the new book in your bag.

en|girl|legacy.action.leave-bread.text: Leave bread until tomorrow. Markdown bread spoils, fresh lasts one more day. Replacement costs money; losses are not refunded.

en|girl|legacy.action.leave-change.text: Leave with three yuan, eighty cents short. The remaining change is still yours; return to collect it.

en|girl|legacy.action.load-wallet.text: Load five cash yuan into the wallet. Cash falls five, digital rises five; total unchanged.

en|girl|legacy.action.loan-work.text: Finish the agreed job; paid once, to help repay the loan.

en|girl|legacy.action.make-list.text: Write a list: each child needs apples and bread. Hear the per-child and total budgets.

en|girl|legacy.action.observe-shelf.text: Observe scarcity and high prices. Scarce apples cost more; delivery takes time.

en|girl|legacy.action.offer-swap.text: Offer one sticker for one apple. Keep one sticker; wait for consent before taking anything.

en|girl|legacy.action.order-home-souveni.text: Choose to buy home shell souvenir. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.pack-lunch.text: Pack apples and bread into each child’s lunch bag.

en|girl|legacy.action.pack-souvenirs.text: Pack one souvenir per child; choose one home or foreign route for this batch.

en|girl|legacy.action.pack-weather.text: Take your purchased rain protection to the park.

en|girl|legacy.action.parent-bank.text: Visit the bank with a parent. No independent child accounts or investing; only your pocket, not parent assets.

en|girl|legacy.action.parent-card-terms.text: Read the simulated parent card terms. Foreign credit is borrowing, not free money. Repay home yuan at the current rate; one late fee of twenty cents.

en|girl|legacy.action.parent-wallet.text: Ask a parent to supervise the digital wallet. No child account; a toy demonstration.

en|girl|legacy.action.pay-bus-qr.text: Choose to buy island bus ticket. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.pay-customs.text: Pay the displayed toy customs charge; correct declarations first.

en|girl|legacy.action.pay-digital.text: Choose to buy prepaid snack. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.pay-note.text: Tender a five-yuan note for bread, then wait for change.

en|girl|legacy.action.pay-parent-card.text: Buy foreign snacks with the simulated parent credit card. Cash unchanged, foreign debt rises, repay at home.

en|girl|legacy.action.pay-sticker-qr.text: Choose to buy prepaid sticker. Hear quantity, unit price, total and budget first. A prepaid wallet spends your own funds; simulated credit leaves a bill to repay.

en|girl|legacy.action.picnic-work.text: Finish picnic preparation; collect agreed pay once. Family size changes pay and quantities.

en|girl|legacy.action.plan-trip.text: Budget with a parent: per child, transport one yuan, room share one yuan twenty, and at least three yuan for later.

en|girl|legacy.action.read-customs.text: Read toy customs: foreign gifts above four yuan cost sixty cents, not real policy. Declare quantity and value; hear the base charge.

en|girl|legacy.action.read-exchange.text: Read the board: one shell equals two yuan. Five shells cost ten yuan plus twenty cents; exchange back also costs twenty cents. A shell has one hundred small units.

en|girl|legacy.action.read-forecast.text: Read tomorrow’s forecast and rain-gear prices. Rain changes umbrella prices; raincoats stay the same.

en|girl|legacy.action.read-home-bill.text: Read rate, foreign balance and debt, fees and due date on the home bill, with parent-supervised simulated credit.

en|girl|legacy.action.read-loan.text: Read principal, daily rate and due date. Friends may charge no interest; interest-bearing loans accrue on principal once a day. Borrowing does not grow net worth.

en|girl|legacy.action.read-tags.text: Read tags and each child’s budget before buying.

en|girl|legacy.action.refund-card-snacks.text: Return unopened card snacks to reduce foreign card debt, not receive cash. No refund after settlement.

en|girl|legacy.action.repair-trust.text: Apologize and mark the next date together. Repay first; repairing trust pays no money.

en|girl|legacy.action.repay.text: Repay all principal and interest. If late, repay first, then plan dates to repair trust.

en|girl|legacy.action.reserve-two.text: Keep two yuan in the jar. It remains cash, reserved this story without interest.

en|girl|legacy.action.return-plush.text: Return the unopened plush for exactly four yuan. Choose a smaller gift, with no extra money.

en|girl|legacy.action.review-card-bill.text: Inspect the new home bill. The exchange rate changes its value; cash is not auto-deducted. Repay next story.

en|girl|legacy.action.ride-island-bus.text: Pay each child’s prepaid fare and ride the island bus, without borrowing.

en|girl|legacy.action.seal-reserve.text: Label and reserve two yuan. A book uses another two; the remote duck must wait.

en|girl|legacy.action.seal-trip-budget.text: Buy tickets and room shares, reserve next-leg funds, then depart.

en|girl|legacy.action.serve-bread.text: Serve edible bread to each child, never spoiled bread.

en|girl|legacy.action.settle-parent-card.text: Settle the parent card in yuan at the current rate, including late fees, not a second snack charge.

en|girl|legacy.action.share-apples.text: Share the apples at home, with one for each child.

en|girl|legacy.action.share-swap-snack.text: Share the swapped and purchased apples; keep one sticker.

en|girl|legacy.action.show-room.text: Show your finished room to a parent.

en|girl|legacy.action.sort-socks.text: Sort socks and books. Give siblings manageable tasks and share the credit.

en|girl|legacy.action.sort-stickers.text: Sort two existing duplicate stickers once; this is not printing money.

en|girl|legacy.action.start-picnic.text: Enjoy a picnic with apples, bread and juice for every child; savings withdrawn and debts settled.

en|girl|legacy.action.sweep-room.text: Sweep together. This agreement pays once, not daily button money.

en|girl|legacy.action.travel-envelope.text: Collect the children’s travel envelope once; parent costs are separate.

en|girl|legacy.action.unload-truck.text: Open crates to observe, without payment. Apple prices change from one yuan fifty to eighty cents.

en|girl|legacy.action.wait-bank.text: Wait one game-day and check maturity. Interest settles once only when due; early withdrawal forfeits it.

en|girl|legacy.action.wait-crowd.text: Wait one game-day for the crowd to leave; existing loan interest advances too.

en|girl|legacy.action.wait-delivery.text: Wait one game-day for delivery. Dates and existing interest advance too.

en|girl|legacy.action.wait-due.text: Wait one game-day to the repayment date; interest-bearing loans add one day’s simple interest.

en|girl|legacy.action.wait-late.text: Play two days and repay late. Trust drops one; interest continues. Repay and apologize to recover.

en|girl|legacy.action.wait-weather.text: Sleep and inspect the sky. Tomorrow’s tags appear first; owned rain gear has no extra price charge.

en|girl|legacy.action.withdraw.text: Withdraw the bank balance into cash without increasing total wealth. Early principal withdrawal forfeits interest; redeposit is possible.

en|girl|legacy.allowance.body.text: A parent sets out spend, keep and share jars: money does not grow daily. Collect this week’s six yuan, reserve two yuan, buy a two yuan book, then check the plan.

en|girl|legacy.bank-plan.body.text: A parent: this is your pocket, not the family’s wealth. Keep two yuan for tomorrow and read today. Collect six yuan allowance, deposit two yuan with a parent, buy a two yuan book and wait one game-day.

en|girl|legacy.bank-term.body.text: Beaver Banker: toy bank, one percent simple interest per game-day. Early withdrawal returns principal only; not real returns. With a parent, deposit three yuan for two game-days, withdraw three yuan and six cents, then buy one yuan supplies.

en|girl|legacy.barter.body.text: Le has apples; you have duplicate stickers. A swap needs two happy yeses. Sort two stickers, trade one for an apple, then buy one extra apple per child.

en|girl|legacy.birthday.body.text: Grandma says: you choose. A giant plush eats the envelope; a small gift brings smiles too. Receive four yuan gift money, buy a present from it, and keep at least one yuan.

en|girl|legacy.borrow.body.text: Le says: borrow two yuan and return it tomorrow. A loan is not a gift. Agree to borrow two yuan, buy a three yuan shared book, do a job and repay tomorrow.

en|girl|legacy.change.body.text: Baker Bee tried calling her calculator. Help check your change! Pay five yuan for one yuan and twenty cents bread, collect the right change, and deliver it.

en|girl|legacy.chores.body.text: A parent says: the sock monster took the sofa! Share jobs, not sibling jobs. Assign shared chores, sort and sweep, then collect one agreed payment.

en|girl|legacy.common.already.text: Already done: no repeated payments, borrowing or purchases.

en|girl|legacy.common.borrow-result.text: The borrowed money reached your pocket and debt rose too. Principal, daily rate and due date are recorded; this is not income.

en|girl|legacy.common.card-refund-result.text: Unopened snacks returned and their debt reversed. No cash or shells were paid out.

en|girl|legacy.common.cash-purchase.text: This purchase uses your own cash. Hear the quantity, price and budget before deciding.

en|girl|legacy.common.change-result.text: The change collected this time is back in your pocket. Uncollected change remains owed by the shopkeeper, not a new reward.

en|girl|legacy.common.changes.text: Here is what that choice changed.

en|girl|legacy.common.complete.text: Complete! Pouch choices became everyday smiles. Hear changes in money and goods.

en|girl|legacy.common.consume-result.text: The goods have been shared. Every child received a portion; shared goods are no longer in your bag.

en|girl|legacy.common.deposit-result.text: Cash moved equally into savings. Principal is still yours; interest settles at the agreed maturity, not as repeated daily rewards.

en|girl|legacy.common.early-result.text: Principal withdrawn early; unmatured interest was forfeited. You can redeposit and wait for maturity.

en|girl|legacy.common.foreign-purchase.text: Buy with your own shell-wallet money; the price is in shells.

en|girl|legacy.common.funds.text: This pouch or budget is not enough. Hear costs and check other work or recovery; retry is available.

en|girl|legacy.common.fx-result.text: Exchange completed. One pouch fell and the other rose; the fee is the part spent. Rate changes also revalue foreign money and debt in home currency.

en|girl|legacy.common.liquidity-held.text: The bank has set aside settlement money that unlocks in a few days. If repayment comes first, it can sell pledged bonds, invite new shareholder cash, or wait for the money to unlock.

en|girl|legacy.common.matured.text: Maturity interest is recorded in savings; principal remains at the bank.

en|girl|legacy.common.obligations-pendin.text: Shop, bank or trade obligations remain. Use the repayment or waiting choices below before closing the album.

en|girl|legacy.common.prepaid-purchase.text: You spend your own money already loaded into the digital wallet, not a loan.

en|girl|legacy.common.prepare.text: Finish the preparation first, then hear this choice's agreement.

en|girl|legacy.common.purchase.text: Payment, goods and bills updated. Hear changes: prepaid is not borrowing; credit must be repaid.

en|girl|legacy.common.purchase-result.text: Payment completed. Bought goods are in your bag; the seller received the money.

en|girl|legacy.common.refund-result.text: Return completed and the matching goods went back. A cash purchase refunds its original price; card snacks reverse their debt, with no free payout.

en|girl|legacy.common.repay-result.text: This debt was repaid. Cash and matching debt fell together, not a second purchase. If it was late, apologize and plan the next date.

en|girl|legacy.common.reserve-result.text: The reserve label is on. The money is still in your pocket, set aside this story without interest.

en|girl|legacy.common.spoiled-result.text: Markdown bread spoiled and cannot be served. No refund for the loss; buy fresh replacement or retry this story to continue.

en|girl|legacy.common.stock.text: This item was bought, sold out today, or an alternative was chosen. Check preparation and other choices.

en|girl|legacy.common.swap-result.text: Both sides exchanged together. Stickers fell, apples rose and cash stayed unchanged.

en|girl|legacy.common.time.text: Game days moved forward. Prices, dates and agreed interest updated; hear the new bill before paying.

en|girl|legacy.common.updated.text: This action was processed. Hear the agreement and current goods, pouches and debt.

en|girl|legacy.common.visit.text: Rest here. Hear today's goal, then follow footprints to the story.

en|girl|legacy.common.wallet-result.text: Cash and prepaid digital money have been transferred. Both are your own money, not borrowing; transferring does not raise the total.

en|girl|legacy.common.withdraw-result.text: The bank balance moved back to your pocket. Early withdrawal earns no interest for this term; principal is not new income.

en|girl|legacy.common.work.text: Agreed work is done and payment arrived. No sneaky naps for Sock Monster!

en|girl|legacy.currency.body.text: Captain Coin: five one yuan coins equal one five yuan note! Digital balance is not free money. Change five yuan into coins, load it into a digital wallet with a parent, pay one yuan and return the rest.

en|girl|legacy.demand.body.text: Juice Jo: the race ended and everyone is thirsty! Buy now or after the rush? Check the queue, compare juice prices, buy a cup each and deliver them.

en|girl|legacy.due-date.body.text: Le drew a tomato on the calendar: the red circle means tomorrow, not forever-tomorrow. Borrow three yuan for supplies, do the agreed job and repay by the date; repair trust if late.

en|girl|legacy.due-date.title.text: The red circle on the calendar

en|girl|legacy.first-snack.body.text: Apple Uncle made a fruit caterpillar: check the price before choosing! Buy an apple for each child within one yuan each, then share them.

en|girl|legacy.foreign-exchange.body.text: Parrot Teller: one shell = two yuan, with zero yuan and twenty cents per exchange. A QR payment can spend your own money, not borrow! Read fictional rates and fees, exchange for five shell coins, then pay children’s bus fares from the prepaid wallet.

en|girl|legacy.foreign-exchange.title.text: Shell coins are not free shells

en|girl|legacy.item.fresh.text: fresh bread that keeps until tomorrow

en|girl|legacy.loan-interest.body.text: A parent reads the toy terms: one percent of principal per game-day, four yuan costs four cents a day, not a real loan. Read terms, borrow four yuan for a kit, work, then repay principal plus interest after a game-day.

en|girl|legacy.loan-interest.title.text: A loan with a little tail

en|girl|legacy.markdown.body.text: Baker Bee: markdown bread is tasty today; tomorrow it parties in the compost bin. Compare fresh and same-day markdown bread; prepare edible snacks for every child.

en|girl|legacy.parent-card.body.text: Parent: this is my simulated card, not a child credit account. Credit borrows; names like Alipay or PayPal alone do not say whether a payment borrows. Check its funding source. With a parent, use a simulated parent credit card for foreign snacks and inspect the home-currency bill after returning.

en|girl|legacy.picnic.body.text: Family outing! Parents pay their own meals; your pocket buys the children’s snacks. Sock Monster brings napkins. Share preparation, withdraw available savings, buy each child apple, bread and juice, and leave no debt.

en|girl|legacy.school-list.body.text: Bear the shopkeeper says: a toy dinosaur wants in, but lunch cannot be a dinosaur. Pack an apple and bread for each child within two yuan and fifty cents each.

en|girl|legacy.supply.body.text: Apple Uncle: ducks blocked the truck! Empty shelves changed today’s price. Notice scarce apples cost more; wait for delivery or buy now, then share one each.

en|girl|legacy.toy-customs.body.text: Crab Officer: toy rules, not real customs policy. Overseas gifts above four yuan cost this envelope zero yuan and sixty cents. Declare them; do not disguise them as socks! Read fictional customs rules, declare souvenirs, pay the displayed charge and obtain a stamp.

en|girl|legacy.toy-customs.title.text: A customs stamp is not a sticker

en|girl|legacy.travel-budget.body.text: Parent: let’s visit fictional Shell Island! This envelope covers children, not adult flights. With a parent, budget the children’s travel envelope, book transport and a room share, and reserve next-leg funds.

en|girl|legacy.travel-finale.body.text: Parrot Post: repay in yuan at home; do not throw away shell IOUs! Every child gets a souvenir page. Exchange leftover shells back, settle the parent’s simulated card at the displayed rate, and keep one souvenir per child.

en|girl|legacy.travel-prices.body.text: Shell Seller: the same item is two yuan and sixty cents at home, one shell here; the exchange has a zero yuan and twenty cents fee. Fictional prices today, not a universal bargain rule. Convert home and shell prices for the same souvenir; choose one for each child.

en|girl|legacy.weather.body.text: Cloud the courier brings a forecast: sunny today, maybe rain tomorrow. Umbrella prices change. Read tomorrow’s forecast, buy rain protection and prepare for the park.

en|girl|life.album.bold.text: Picnic together and talk about choices through the years.

en|girl|life.album.goal.text: The child with a little purse has lived a whole story. Photos and family ages remain. There is more than one good path.

en|girl|life.album.result.text: From childhood until now, family and stories are in the album. Replay a chapter to try another route.

en|girl|life.album.safe.text: Garden with family and open the old photos.

en|girl|life.basket.bold.text: Demand crowds in: prices become one point three, two point six and three point nine yuan.

en|girl|life.basket.goal.text: Three goods began at one, two and three yuan. Compare the whole basket, not one apple price alone.

en|girl|life.basket.result.text: Old and new prices of the same basket were recorded. Unchanged money can buy a different amount.

en|girl|life.basket.safe.text: Supply recovers: prices become zero point nine, one point eight and two point seven yuan.

en|girl|life.bond-market.bold.text: Receive the coupon, then sell to another investor for nine yuan.

en|girl|life.bond-market.goal.text: Coupon stays zero point five yuan, but resale price changes. Secondary-sale money goes to the seller, not the issuer again.

en|girl|life.bond-market.result.text: A bond resale swaps money between holders; it does not fund the issuer again. Its market price can change.

en|girl|life.bond-market.safe.text: Receive the coupon and hold; today’s quote is ten point five yuan.

en|girl|life.bond.bold.text: Pay ten yuan for a new bond; money goes to the bakery company.

en|girl|life.bond.goal.text: A bond is a loan promise: principal ten yuan, fixed coupon zero point five, maturity in three turns.

en|girl|life.bond.result.text: A bond records principal and interest separately. Its holder has a claim and the shop has a repayment obligation.

en|girl|life.bond.safe.text: Skip buying this time and keep cash.

en|girl|life.budget.bold.text: Save another three yuan and keep more cash nearby.

en|girl|life.budget.goal.text: Pay twelve yuan living costs and one per childhood sibling group member. Saving moves money, not creates income.

en|girl|life.budget.result.text: Living costs are paid. Emergency money moved from your pocket to savings; that transfer did not create wealth.

en|girl|life.budget.safe.text: Move another ten yuan into emergency savings.

en|girl|life.children.bold.text: Care for two children for six yuan this turn.

en|girl|life.children.goal.text: Now you have your own family. Children grow with the chapters. Care needs money and time.

en|girl|life.children.result.text: New babies joined your family. Care needs money and shared family time.

en|girl|life.children.safe.text: Care for one child for three yuan this turn.

en|girl|life.claim.bold.text: Repair with family, then check the same claim rules.

en|girl|life.claim.goal.text: Rain damage costs five or fifteen yuan. Repair first, then claim from the pool within the deductible and limit.

en|girl|life.claim.result.text: Repairs were paid first. Insurance reimburses only loss above the deductible and within its limit.

en|girl|life.claim.safe.text: Report the loss honestly and check covered and uncovered costs.

en|girl|life.constraints.bold.text: Risk is too high and nobody wants to borrow; decline new credit this turn.

en|girl|life.constraints.goal.text: Capital, liquidity, risk and loan demand constrain lending. Reserves times a number do not automatically create loans.

en|girl|life.constraints.result.text: The bank also checks risk, funds and borrower demand. Low rates do not approve every loan.

en|girl|life.constraints.safe.text: Shrink the plan and repay five yuan principal; loans and deposits both fall.

en|girl|life.credit.bold.text: Approve a twenty-yuan business loan: deposits rise twenty, reserves stay put.

en|girl|life.credit.goal.text: A bank loan creates a borrower deposit and bank loan asset, alongside borrower debt. Reserves are not loan assets.

en|girl|life.credit.result.text: The bank added a loan asset and a borrower deposit together. Lending itself did not increase bank reserves.

en|girl|life.credit.safe.text: Approve a ten-yuan business loan: deposits rise ten, reserves stay put.

en|girl|life.credit.title.text: A loan makes two matching records

en|girl|life.demand.bold.text: Charge one point six yuan each; sell up to four today.

en|girl|life.demand.goal.text: A higher price need not earn more. Unsold bread becomes compost, not spendable cash.

en|girl|life.demand.result.text: Customers buy some bread; unsold bread expires and loses its inventory value. A large backlog also costs twenty yuan to clear. A sole owner covers the shortfall; a limited company keeps its own unpaid debt.

en|girl|life.demand.safe.text: Charge one yuan each; sell up to eight today.
